cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You moved your name card to this table, so I moved mine beside it. You'll agree I should sit here now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the waiter. That card says reserved, not my name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Reserved together. You could approve one place for me before the rest arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's reserved for the choir. Are you singing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Whichever song they start with. Could you leave my place set while I find someone singing my part?

reason: Replace removable confidence wrappers with an explicit copied cue, revealed misunderstanding and face-saving continuation of the same Drive pursuit.
